title: K2 Space news
description: A "recent news" row: a 47.6px title with two square arrow buttons, over a swipeable row of near-black cards (598×370 at 1440) that run off the right edge. Each card has the publication's name in bold top-left, a small grey date top-right, the headline low down and a quiet grey "read" link that lights up when the card is hovered. The title rises 15px into view.
notes: publications are plain text names, never logos
the row is a native scroll-snap scroller (swipe on phones); the arrows need JavaScript
